messages:
Evan R: opened PR #5017 to add note about the new `--redact-identifiers` CLI flag for audit exports. Legal found examples with emails, so we should update the example output. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5017

docs-bot: PR 5017 preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/pr-5017  build ok

Priya (legal): thanks. prefer 'personal identifiers (e.g., email, phone)' in the copy and do not show real emails in example rows. Also include a short callout: 'Customers are responsible for downstream retention and must comply with applicable laws.'

Sam J: I'll change the sample row to pseudonymized values (user_id: 'anon-2023') and show the CLI example: `redwood export --id 1234 --redact-identifiers > audit.json`

Tasha M: ops note: we changed timestamps to RFC3339; add a one-line parse example for bash/jq to convert or validate. e.g. `jq '.[] | .ts' audit.json` is safer than assuming integers.

Evan R: sounds good. I'll push a small migration blurb mentioning epoch-ms -> RFC3339 and add the legal wording changes.

Priya (legal): looks good, add link to the DPA page for extended retention requests.

Sam J: pushed commit 9f1c2d with pseudonymized rows, CLI flag snippet, and migration note. ping for final review.

Evan R: quick pass done, merging after CI green. thanks all :thumbsup:
